# weka_ldap (Data Source)

The cluster LDAP configuration. There is one per cluster; the API does not return reader_password, so it stays null here.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `base_dn` (String) Base DN for LDAP searches.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cluster uses LDAP for authentication.
- `group_id_attribute` (String) Attribute used as the group id.
- `group_membership_attribute` (String) Attribute listing the members of a group.
- `group_object_class` (String) Object class of a group entry.
- `id` (String) Always `cluster`.
- `reader_password` (String, Sensitive) Not returned by the API; always null here.
- `reader_username` (String) Account the cluster uses to query the directory.
- `server_uri` (String) LDAP server URI.
- `user_id_attribute` (String) Attribute used as the user id.
- `user_object_class` (String) Object class of a user entry.
